error[ZC-E0116]: can't use the state directory
  cause  neither XDG_STATE_HOME nor HOME names an absolute directory
  fix    name one:   export XDG_STATE_HOME=$HOME/.local/state
  more   zcube explain E0116 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0116.html
